'''Redwood trees''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] that could be found on a number of [[Planet/Legends|planets]], including [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], and were harvested as a source of [[Carbon/Legends|carbon]].
